title: Chapter 218
text:
Wild Boy, a member of Sky Territory, and a loyal fan of Pork Bun.

There were many Galaxy video hosts with different styles on the forum, but only Pork Bun had first-hand information about Black Phantom, so he was always ahead of the other video hosts. Wild Boy liked to watch videos related to Black Phantom very much. He was fascinated by the dark and mysterious aura of Black Phantom.

Once Pork Bun updated, Wild Boy saw it. He clicked on it immediately and posted a comment before watching it. "International practice, rush for updates before watching!"

The video started playing, and Pork Bun's despicable voice sounded.

"Snow white legs and cherry lips, peeling skin and breaking bones to suck human marrow, take off those clothes and pants, wine doesn't make people drunk, just a cup of aphrodisiac, in exchange for a night without sagging! Alright, welcome to Galaxy Adventure Diary, dog viewers, I'm still me, a different Pork Bun! "

Wild Boy spat out a mouthful of water. It was the usual opening poem in every episode, and the lyrics were getting more and more flirtatious. Even with a strong ID, he felt that his body could not take it anymore.

Every time the opening poem was released, the comments would go crazy, so dense that even the screen could not be seen clearly.

"I used to be a civil and military strategist, but now I only know how to shout 666."

"The theme is clear, so wet, so wet."

"I'm calling the police!"

"I'm a girl, and I actually sang along …"

"Filthy power overflows the sky!"

"Let's have another one of the falling lotus!"

"So cool, I can't stop!"

"Please consider the feelings of the female fans! You'll lose the babies if you do this! "

"Reported, no shooting!"

The previous episode was Pork Bun and Mad Blade causing trouble in Black Pine. This episode continued from the previous one, and everyone watched with great interest. After completing the mission, in the second half of the episode, the scene suddenly changed to a huge city under construction, and the bright 'Bennett's Sanctuary One' jumped into everyone's eyes.

In the scene, Han Xiao, dressed in black, stood with his hands behind his back.

The comments paused for a moment, then suddenly exploded.

"Wow, I see Uncle Black again!"

"Video host with a conscience, eat one of my recommendation tickets."

After so many days, they finally saw Black Phantom appear in Pork Bun's video in person. This was the only one. The audience felt a sense of familiarity, as if they were seeing a familiar face.

Since the start of the open beta, Han Xiao had been in the eyes of the players. He had a special place in the hearts of the players.

Wild Boy opened his eyes wide, not wanting to miss a single second.

"Black Phantom brought us to a special scene that was under construction. During this time, I found a main mission on Black Phantom …"

There was a lot of discussion in the bullet screen. The players all knew that Han Xiao had a Main Storyline Mission, and the requirements for accepting the Hidden Main Storyline Mission were very strict. Could it be that this Main Storyline Mission was different?

Pork Bun showed his mission list, and it was a shiny new mission, [Black Phantom Sanctuary Three]!

"What is this?"

"The mission name actually has Black Phantom in it …"

"What is a shelter?"

"Hmm, it's very similar to the name of this scene."

Pork Bun revealed the inside story with an excited tone. The Dark Net was going to build a shelter, and Black Phantom was going to bring a team of thousands of people to Graymetal Ruins to build a city. They could get the hint from Han Xiao.

This time, there was no need for any prerequisites, and the mission could be triggered easily.

After listening to the mission description, the bullet screen was filled with shock again.

"It's building a city. God, what a huge main storyline. The scale is almost the same as the expedition war."

"This is also Blue Star's main storyline!"

Wild Boy paused the video, opened his eyes wide, and carefully read the mission description a few times. He swallowed his saliva and continued playing.

He did not have time to think about what a shelter was. He saw Han Xiao in the video talking loudly to his subordinates.

"The dark clouds of war covered the blue sky like the wings of death. The wounds of the previous generation were torn apart by blood before they could heal. Only a few decades have passed, and no one will forget the pain that war brought to the world. Until today, it still affects the land under our feet, the blue sky above our heads, radiation, dust, death, and the extinction of the country!

How ridiculous. After the old era, our civilian technology regressed, but the military technology used to deal with our own kind continued to develop. They fought for ideology and national interests, spreading death with steel and fire!

For these empty and false reasons, they slaughtered their own kind! Countless lives will be taken away by the whirlpool of war! The world will be devastated by them, and it will be on the decline. Maybe the end of the world will come quietly one day. Building a shelter is for the continuation of civilization. Even if the world is destroyed tomorrow, I will preserve the last spark of civilization!

I am not great, but too many people are insignificant.

If no one is willing to contribute, fine, I will go first!

I know, I won't be the last! "

Han Xiao's tone was rhythmic. Wild Boy held his breath. Even through the screen, he could feel a surge of passion in his heart. It was so infectious!

Wild Boy was not the only one who was shocked. "I am not great, but too many people are insignificant" appeared on the screen. There were even three exclamation marks. It looked very impressive.

"So you are this kind of Black Phantom!" There were also a series of such comments floating on the screen. In their impression, Black Phantom was a man of few words, but this speech changed his image. Many players had a clearer understanding of Han Xiao. They did not expect Black Phantom to be so ambitious.

After watching it, Wild Boy's emotions surged.

At this time, he saw an announcement from Jade Green Sky in the guild channel.

"Attention, everyone. The guild is collecting the coordinates and information of the Graymetal Ruins. Those who provide information will be rewarded."

…

Rewind time to one day ago.

Han Xiao gathered the team of a thousand people that followed him to build the city, mobilized them before departure, and made the speech in the video. At that time, Bennett just wanted Han Xiao to say something casually. He did not expect him to say such a big thing. He was shocked like everyone else.

The surrounding workers put down their work and gradually gathered. The number of people increased, and they looked up at Han Xiao on the stage.

Seeing the excited look on everyone's face, Han Xiao knew that the effect would be explosive. He copied this speech from the future Bennett to shock everyone. In the past, Bennett had established his position in the hearts of the players with his noble aspirations. Han Xiao said it first. No matter what, when Bennett was mentioned in the future, the players would definitely think of him. This deepened the players' impression of him and added additional value to his character.

He knew that the players liked to see things like this. A character with noble aspirations was usually a selling point. Furthermore, Bennett did not need to care about the players' image of him, so Han Xiao did not refuse.

At the same time, he could also move Bennett. There were many benefits.

"Players all like the additional story of a character. Showing some special characteristics will help to gain the players' favor." Han Xiao nodded. He wanted the players to follow the image he created. As for whether this was true or not, if he did not say it, no one would know.

She turned around and saw that Bennett's expression had changed. What she had said had struck a chord in his heart …

Of course, those were his own words to begin with.

Bennett was deeply touched. Han Xiao had said what was in his heart. He only felt that Han Xiao was becoming more and more pleasing to the eye.

Just like rain dripping into a dry desert, Bennett realized that he was no longer alone. He finally found a comrade.

"Everything is for the continuation of civilization. He understands me." Bennett gave Han Xiao a gratified look.

Speech was a very scary skill. It could motivate people. Originally, most of the workers here came to work for the money, but now they felt that there was something more in their hearts.

The directors were shocked. They did not expect Black Phantom, who had killed countless people, to have such perseverance. They looked at him in a new light.

…

The next day, the construction team of Fallout Shelter Three gathered. The massive fleet of vehicles dragged a cloud of smoke behind them as they passed through the barren fields and disappeared into the horizon.

The fleet was equipped with a reconnaissance helicopter that flew at low altitude. It was the vehicle of important people. If there was any danger, they could escape. However, since Han Xiao chose to take the car, Huang Yu took the helicopter without hesitation. He did not bother to be polite with Han Xiao.

Han Xiao felt the vibration of the off-road truck in the back seat and browsed through the team's information.

At this time, a notification appeared on the interface.

Current Goal: Protect the fleet and reach Graymetal Ruins

Current Team Size: 1,034

When reaching the destination, the team's loss rate is below 20%. Reward: 250000 EXP. Mission Rating increased. Current Rating: E

The sudden appearance of the mission target is a feature of a long-term mission. Han Xiao raised his eyebrows. He suddenly realized that his eyebrows had been too active recently. No, I have to be more careful.

[Sanctuary Three]'s Mission Rating changed in real time. When the requirements were completed, the rating would increase. Since the mission had just started, he had not done anything yet. Of course, it would be the lowest Level E rating.

The team consisted of seven hundred workers and technicians. The remaining three hundred were soldiers and guards. They were organized into teams of twenty, guarding the periphery of the fleet.

The armed forces are not enough. I have to strengthen the team.
